text: dsh-trajectory-persistence 是 DSH 会话轨迹插件，监听会话事件并将数据送往 S3 或 OpenTelemetry。S3 push 模式将事件缓冲为 JSONL 分片；ship 模式读取本地 zstd 会话文件并按帧分段上传。OTel sink 将回合、模型步骤和工具调用映射为 GenAI spans，可通过 OTLP 或 AWS SigV4 导出。另支持设置热更新、状态命令和从 S3 恢复会话。适合需要归档、观察或迁移 DSH 会话的用户。所有 sink 默认关闭，启用后需配置存储桶或遥测端点。

dsh-trajectory-persistence archives DSH session trajectories to S3 and exports OpenTelemetry GenAI spans. S3 push sends buffered JSONL parts; ship uploads frame-aligned zstd segments. OTel maps turns and tool calls to spans. It also supports session restoration. Sinks are disabled by default.
想把 DSH 会话轨迹持续归档到 S3 或兼容对象存储。

dsh-trajectory-persistence 的功能「S3 push 归档」：将实时会话事件缓冲并序列化为 JSONL 分片，按项目、会话和序号写入 S3 兼容存储；批量上传支持重试。
dsh-trajectory-persistence 的功能「S3 ship 归档」：读取官方会话后端的本地 zstd 轨迹文件，按完整帧切分上传，并用清单记录同步进度。
dsh-trajectory-persistence 的功能「GenAI 遥测导出」：把 DSH 会话事件映射为回合、模型步骤及工具调用 spans，再通过 OTLP 导出。
dsh-trajectory-persistence 的功能「AWS 遥测导出」：将 OTLP trace 请求以 AWS SigV4 签名发送到 CloudWatch 或 AgentCore 可观测性端点。
dsh-trajectory-persistence 的功能「会话恢复」：sync-down 从对象存储读取分段和清单，在本机重建官方会话轨迹文件，并报告恢复或冲突结果。
dsh-trajectory-persistence 使用者须知：启用 S3 或 OTel sink 后，会话轨迹事件或其映射 spans 会发送到所配置的对象存储或遥测端点；两个 sink 默认均关闭。
dsh-trajectory-persistence 使用者须知：sync-down 会在配置的本地会话根目录创建或更新 session.jsonl.zstd；CLI 文档要求恢复时 DSH 不要同时运行。

Trajectory persistence plugin for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`).
Observe-only: it never writes to a session — it persists every session's
trajectory to two **independently toggleable** sinks:

dsh-trajectory-persistence README · dsh-trajectory-persistence：- **S3 sink** — archive the raw trajectory to S3 / OSS / MinIO. Two modes:
  `ship` tails the official jsonl backend's on-disk artifact read-only and
  uploads **byte-faithful zstd frame segments + manifest**, restorable on
  another machine with the bundled `sync-down` CLI; `push` (legacy, default)
  buffers the live event stream and uploads JSONL part files with batch,
  backoff retry, and a local dead-letter directory.
- **OTel GenAI sink** — spans following the
  [OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/gen-ai/)
  (turn / model-call / tool tree with token usage and error status), exported
  over OTLP HTTP/protobuf to Jaeger, an OTel Collector, Langfuse, or
  **SigV4-signed straight to AWS CloudWatch / Bedrock AgentCore Observability**
  — no collector required.

dsh-trajectory-persistence README · dsh-trajectory-persistence：Extras: settings **hot-reload** with per-sink rebuild, `/trajectory-status`
slash command, sync-down restore with no-overwrite / prefix-append /
conflict-refuse semantics.

dsh-trajectory-persistence README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-trajectory-persistence
```

All sinks default to **disabled**. Enable what you need in
`$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml` (applies live, no restart):

```yaml
trajectory-persistence:
  sinks:
    s3:
      enabled: true

Move a session to another machine:

```sh

dsh-trajectory-persistence README · machine B, dsh not running — restores sessions from the bucket into the local root：dsh-trajectory-persistence sync-down --bucket my-trajectory-bucket --region us-east-1
dsh resume <session>
```
